# Requirements Quality Review Checklist: spec-001 — Alta de Empleados y Trayectoria Contractual

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality unit test suite validating the completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and constitutional alignment of spec-001.
**Created**: 2026-10-27
**Feature**: [specs/spec-001/spec.md](file:///c:/Users/jotan/Desktop/IW/recursos-humanos-IW/specs/spec-001/spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## 1. Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are mandatory employee identification fields (name, surnames, national ID, corporate email) explicitly enumerated for the registration process? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are mandatory initial contractual conditions (position, department, gross annual salary, collective agreement, team manager) fully specified for the hire event? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK003 Is the exact mechanism for auto-generating and displaying provisional user credentials specified without requiring external SMTP infrastructure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Clarification 2026-10-27]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements specified for updating non-contractual personal contact data independently of append-only contractual history? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK005 Are the consequences and state changes of logical employee deactivation (`active = false`) explicitly documented across user access accounts and historical records? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]

## 2. Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [x] CHK006 Is the monetary precision and scale of the salary attribute explicitly quantified to prevent floating-point discrepancies? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Constitution Art. 8.3]
- [x] CHK007 Is the hierarchy exception rule allowing a null manager exclusively for "Dirección General / CEO" defined with exact matching criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK008 Is the concept of effective date (`effective_from`) defined as an immutable business date (`LocalDate`) distinct from the audit timestamp (`created_at`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Constitution Art. 14]
- [x] CHK009 Is the chronological ordering rule for reconstructing contractual history explicitly specified for tie-breaking when two events share the same effective date? [Clarity, Spec §1. Acceptance Scenario 5]

## 3. Requirement Consistency & Constitutional Invariants

- [x] CHK010 Do the contract modification requirements strictly adhere to the constitutional append-only invariant forbidding in-place updates or deletions? [Consistency, Constitution Art. 11, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK011 Is server-side role authorization strictly restricted to `RRHH` across all mutating employee and contract endpoints? [Consistency, Constitution Art. 10, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK012 Are error response requirements consistently aligned with the RFC 9457 Problem Details standard, including per-field error mapping? [Consistency, Constitution Art. 19, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK013 Does the specification align with the constitutional four-layer architecture prohibiting frontend components from executing domain business logic? [Consistency, Constitution Art. 5, Art. 6]

## 4. Acceptance Criteria Quality & Measurability

- [x] CHK014 Is success criterion SC-001 ("complete registration in less than 2 minutes") objectively measurable and testable under realistic user conditions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK015 Is success criterion SC-002 ("100% of contractual changes recorded without destructive overwrites") defined with verifiable persistence verification criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK016 Does the acceptance criteria define explicit HTTP status codes (201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found) for all outcome paths? [Measurability, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios]
- [x] CHK017 Are negative authorization acceptance scenarios specified with expected status codes for non-HR roles (`EMPLEADO`, `RESPONSABLE_EQUIPO`)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §1. Acceptance Scenario 6]

## 5. Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Are requirements documented for retroactive contract variations with effective dates in the past and their integration into chronological history? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, Clarification 2026-10-27]
- [x] CHK019 Are requirements documented for future-dated contract modifications and their effect on currently active contractual conditions? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Is the rejection behavior specified when a contract variation request omits an effective date? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, Acceptance Scenario 4]
- [x] CHK021 Are collision and duplicate handling requirements defined for unique constraints on national ID (NIF/NIE) and corporate email? [Edge Cases, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements specified for handling inactive employees attempting authentication or being selected as managers for new hires? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]

## 6. Non-Functional & Security Requirements

- [x] CHK023 Are data protection and credential secrecy requirements specified to prevent passwords and personal data from appearing in logs or error traces? [Security, Constitution Art. 20, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK024 Are WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility requirements specified for all form inputs, validation error indicators (`mat-error`), and modal dialogs? [Accessibility, Constitution Art. 21, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK025 Are audit trail requirements (`created_by`, `created_at`) specified for every contractual variation and employee registration? [Auditability, Spec §SC-004, Constitution Art. 8.4]

## 7. Dependencies & Assumptions Validation

- [x] CHK026 Is the dependency on pre-existing collective agreements (`collective_agreements`) documented with validation rules for non-existent IDs? [Dependency, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK027 Is the assumption that authentication provides the caller's identity and role in the session/token validated against current security architecture? [Assumption, Spec §4. Assumptions]
- [x] CHK028 Are integration requirements between the employee domain and future leave balance computation (spec-002/spec-003) clearly delineated? [Dependency, Spec §Key Entities]
